_comment: Mosaic slices S5 and S6 on the real page (#189; spec 2026-09-23 flows mosaic, section 8 S5 and S6, and S4's probe as the precedent: visible=true, a view marker on every walk). S5: a rotating 2x2 flow started on the simulator by its RUN button, the phone stage sheet's readouts naming the engine's panel and pass while RUN reads STOP, the Target modal opening view-only with the shooting panel, and after Abort, RUN reading CONTINUE with the progress route's numbers and START OVER behind a confirm. S6: Sky FRAME and the classic Atlas each hand their framing to SEND TO FLOW WIZARD, whose steps end on a review of exactly one TARGET, with no Plan targets left behind. Phone walks at 390 x 844 with touch, desktop walks at 1440 x 900, every one by the clicks a person makes, never a deep link. Run against a LOCAL simulator server only, never the rig: `python tools/ui_probe/server_ctl.py start --fresh --port 8857` (any port but 8800; it connects the simulator), then `python tools/ui_probe/probe.py --routes tools/ui_probe/routes_s5_s6.json --widths 390,1440 --port 8857 --out .probe/out/s5-s6`, then `server_ctl.py stop`. The widths must run 390 first: the desktop's seed refuses an engine the phone left running. The probe's own cases for this file are test_probe_s5_s6.py.
_order: The walks are one night in order, because the engine is one engine. At 390: s5-run-phone presses RUN and leaves the run going; s5-frame-running-phone opens the Target modal while it runs; s5-continue-phone waits for the first banked sub, presses STOP, and grades CONTINUE and START OVER's confirm; s6-sky-wizard-phone and s6-atlas-wizard-phone each save a flow through the wizard. At 1440 the same on the classic editor and the classic Atlas, on a second flow, and s6-sky-wizard-desktop. Each route is a fresh page, so each proves its own door; the run is the server's, so it outlives the page that started it. Since H4 the night begins with s5-frame-catalogue-pick-phone, which opens the phone's flow's Target modal and picks a WHERE result with one tap before anything runs: after s5-run-phone that modal is view-only.
_seed: First `require_sim`: these walks press RUN, so the probe refuses a server whose rig is not the simulator (GET /api/status `mode`), at every width, before anything is saved or pressed. Then two flows DRAWN here, not copied from the eighth Example: that one waits for dusk (its DUSK node), autofocuses and guides, and its 120 s subs would keep a walk minutes from its first frame. Each is ONE TARGET of 2 x 2 panels at PA 55, rotating (the loop wire from the FILTER CYCLE's 'pass done' to the TARGET's 'next panel'), with 20 passes of one 10 s L sub, so 80 subs: on the simulator the first slew and centre take about 28 s, the first autofocus 28 s more, and then a sub lands every 12 s, the panel changing with every pass (measured 2026-09-28). With no DUSK node the run starts now, and with no site set nothing gates it on altitude. The TARGET is framed for the simulator's field, 0.494 x 0.371 deg (the compile's rig facts on a fresh config), and `runnable` refuses a server whose compile would call that a loss, since RUN would then stop on a question the walk does not answer. `fresh` refuses a server that already holds a session for the flow, or whose engine is running: this walk must be the flow's first run. The phone's flow is seeded only at 390 and the desktop's only at 1440 (seed `widths`), because a flow seeded again after its walk would find its own session and refuse.
_names: The flow names are short on purpose: the phone footer's RUN button is the screen less its gutters, 358 px, and CONTINUE's line is the verb, the name and the parenthetical, of which only the name may be cut (runCopy.ts). 'M31 2x2' fits beside '(night 1, n/80 subs)' there (routes_s7.json's CONTINUE walks read night 2, one character no wider), so the probe can hold that NO text is cut, the name included, rather than exempting the one part the design lets go.
_found: Found by this probe's first walks, 2026-09-28, and each opened and looked at in its screenshots: #463, fixed in the working tree (the phone RUN footer shrunk to its words, stages reading IDLE through the run, ADD STAGE and the LOG squashed, the TONIGHT sub cut, the wizard's title cut and its rail on two baselines, and the probe dying on a reason it could not print); open, in files this task does not own: #464 (flows.statuses never written, both canvases), #465 (the phone modal's sky clips its degraded line; s5-frame-running-phone stays red), #466 (the Sky hub judges FRAME at the placeholder site), #467 (RunControls buzzes on mount; s6-sky-wizard-desktop stays red), #468 (the desktop session column misdescribes a flow's run), #469 (the 'While a mosaic waits' select cut); and more evidence on #357 (the classic TARGET card's footer). Found by H4-PROBE-LAYOUT's re-baseline, 2026-09-29: s6-sky-wizard-phone and s6-sky-wizard-desktop are red at FRAME, with scrollbars drawn and hidden alike, since H4-USKY (#503): with no site saved the finder places nothing, so its FRAME is locked, and the refusal says 'Aim above the horizon first' while the reticle reads alt 45 (#568). WP-24a (backlog ruling, owner-approved 2026-09-30): FRAME's refusal now takes its sentence from finder/model.ts (SkyHub.tsx's `frameReason`), and the two S6 Sky walks are restaged through the atlas's own FRAME rather than seeding a site - this file quotes no site value by design (test_probe_s5_s6.py's `test_the_route_file_is_ascii`), so a seeded fixture was not an option here. See each route's own `_note` for the restage. NOT YET WALKED ON THE REAL PAGE: no live simulator server or browser was available to this WP; re-run the probe before trusting the restage the way this field trusts a run that was.
_expected_errors_why: Measured on the sim rig, as routes_s4_frame.json records: no offline sky pack and online fetch off by default, so every survey tile 404s (the console carries only the status text). A fresh config has no site, so the Sky hub's tonight list and visibility answer 409 (the Sky walks only); any other 4xx still fails the route.

It is the first walk of the night because the phone's flow is editable only until s5-run-phone presses RUN (a running flow's modal is view-only and its search is disabled), and it saves nothing: the pick changes the modal's draft, which the next route's fresh page does not have. Then the canvas, MOVE SKY, MOVE GRID and the compass letters must lie whole inside the sky, and neither line over the canvas, with both lines showing (min_b 2).

_mutations: Before any fix (2026-09-28), observed red on the real page: text 'SEND TO FLOW WIZARD - Wild Duck Cluster' (.swz-title) is clipped 5.8px by 'swz-title' (1 of 1 with text) (#463). The object framed varies with the hour, so the title's red is held by s6-atlas-wizard-phone, whose name does not.
routes._note: Sky FRAME to SEND TO FLOW WIZARD to its review. RESTAGED (#568): this used to leave the atlas for the finder and press FRAME there, because the finder frames the reach list's first object whatever the hour, where the atlas's FRAME was once hour-dependent (#466). Since H4-USKY (#503) a default site has no coordinates at all, so the finder places nothing and its FRAME is locked - the atlas's FRAME is the one that stays live on a default site now (`atlasFrameReason` returns null with no site to judge an aim against), so FRAME is pressed there instead, on whatever the atlas's own free-roam session is centred on. That hands FRAME an UNNAMED patch (no catalogue target), so the wizard's target step asks for a name before NEXT opens (`wizard-ask-name`, SendToWizardSheet's NEED_NAME) and this walk types one. The framing is made a 2 x 2, the wizard asks the angle (no angle mode arrives from the Sky card), a filter and the guiding, and GENERATE saves. NOT YET WALKED ON THE REAL PAGE: this restage has not been run against a live simulator server (see this WP's return for the honesty note); re-verify before trusting it the way `_found` trusts a run that was.
